references.text: The law of the red heifer that has never borne a yoke, parallel to the requirement for a young cow that has not been used for work
Cows that have never borne a yoke were used to carry the ark of the covenant, the same principle of using unworked animals for holy purposes
Laws concerning bloodguilt and atonement for the land when a murderer is unknown
Regulations regarding cities of refuge and the handling of murder, part of the same legal context
The blood that cries out from the ground, background for the need for atonement when innocent blood has been shed
